answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral in escrow, and evidence of coordinated equivocation links identities rather than treating them as independent. For k linked identities, the quadratic penalty scales with k(k−1), or O(k²). Detection also applies asymmetric depreciation compounded across the swarm, creating an exponential multiplier in aggregate capital loss. Splitting stake across keys is therefore no oasis; “tide” and “sonnet” are labels, not protocol inputs.
